exposure: high ligation of the umbilical cord
cohort: 5 patients who underwent delayed interval delivery of twins at Fujian Maternal and Child Health Hospital from 2014 to 2018.
finding: Successful performance of delayed interval delivery can improve the survival rates for the second twin and improve prognosis, though careful attention is required to prevent and treat complications.
mod_finding: Of the second twins, 3 were delivered vaginally, 1 via cesarean section, and 1 required a breech extraction.
birth_weight: Average birth weight of the second twin was 957 g (range: 360-1930 g).
gest_age: Average gestational age at delivery of the first child was 23+3 weeks (range: 20+1-30+2 weeks); average gestational age at delivery of the second child was 25+5 weeks (range: 20+4-31+3 weeks).
